# Jekyll migration scaffold

This repo has a basic Jekyll scaffolding with layouts and includes.

Build locally:

```bash
gem install bundler jekyll
bundle init
# Add `gem "jekyll"` to the generated Gemfile, then:
bundle install
bundle exec jekyll serve
```

Notes:
- The site currently references the existing `styles.css` at the repo root. Move SCSS into `_sass/` and update `assets` as desired.
- Convert existing pages to include YAML front matter and `layout: page`.
